recriacao.texto_literal_da_fonte: For the purpose of affording a protected anchorage-ground, as contemplated by the act, it is proposed to construct a breakwater, the position of which is indicated on the map. Starting at the 3-fathom curve at a point inside of Point Fermin, a direction south 47 degrees east is given to the westerly arm of the breakwater for a distance of 3,300 feet, which carries it beyond a line projected from the anchorage-ground to the westerly end of Catalina Island, and gives protection to seas from the southwest. A gap of 1,000 feet is then left, and the westerly arm, 2,500 feet long, running north 75 degrees east, is located so as to extend beyond lines drawn from the anchorage ground as above to the easterly end of Catalina Island and Point San Juan Capistrano
recriacao.localizador: ARCE 1888, App. PP, pp. 2124–2125 (Benyaurd, San Francisco, February 13, 1888); o '2,500' lido na imagem da p. 2124 (o OCR do govinfo dá '2,100')
